  top-ranked grounded candidate when it is not the assigned direction, kicker

  When the assignment IS your top candidate, there is no pick card. Re-roll
  yourself only on named factual grounds, when the assignment cannot carry
  the product's truth or task; taste is never grounds.
  The assignment exists to refuse the model's ranking rut, never to outrank
  the user or the brief. Never expose assignment metadata in user-facing labels.
Present the round through the structured question tool, every option in one
shared anatomy: the assigned direction first, then the pick card when there is
one, then re-roll with its three registers (plain, safer, bolder), and the
standing exit last: the category standard, played straight, offered as the
user's door and never recommended.
PRODUCT.md and explicit incumbent brand commitments constrain every direction.
The seed never chooses exact colors, fonts, tokens, or a user preference, and
it never permits the world and first surface to be selected independently.
A user- or brief-pinned decision beats the roll, always.
